lines.en: label mikudorm10:
I hold my breath as I knock on Miku’s door.
lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，敲响了 Miku 的门。

lines.en: I don't mean to, but I do.
lines.zh: 我不是故意的，但我确实这么做了。

lines.en: I haven’t had a chance to talk to her one-on-one since the episode in the storage room and...
lines.zh: 自从储藏室那件事之后，我一直没机会和她单独谈过……

lines.en: In fact, approaching her at all has started to make me feel a bit uneasy.
lines.zh: 事实上，光是靠近她，就开始让我感到有些不安。

lines.en: I still don’t even understand what happened. That entire morning is just a blur to me, looking back on it now.
lines.zh: 我到现在都不明白发生了什么。如今回想起来，那一整个早晨对我来说只是一片模糊。

lines.en: If something is actually wrong with Miku...I should at least try and figure out what it is...shouldn't I?
lines.zh: 如果 Miku 真的有什么不对劲……我至少该试着弄清楚那是什么……不是吗？

lines.en: I can't guarantee I'll be able to do something about it, but...
lines.zh: 我不能保证自己能为此做些什么，不过……

lines.en: I should at least {i}know.{/i}
lines.zh: 我至少应该{i}知道。{/i}

lines.en: I knock again.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次。

lines.en: I know she's in there.
lines.zh: 我知道她在里面。

lines.en: : Hello?
: It’s me. Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 是我。我能进来吗？

lines.en: : Sensei?...You're here?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……是你来了？……

lines.en: : But...why?
lines.zh: : 可是……为什么？

lines.en: : Why do you think? Just let me in.
lines.zh: : 你觉得是为什么？让我进去就是了。

lines.en: : I mean...are you sure you wanna?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你确定要进来吗？

lines.en: I can hear Miku speaking from right behind the door. I’m guessing she wasn’t expecting me to show up and talk about anything so soon after the incident.
lines.zh: 我能听见 Miku 就在门后说话。我猜她没想到，那件事之后这么快我就会出现，还要谈些什么。

lines.en: : Did you think I was just going to start ignoring you or something?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会开始不理你之类的吗？

lines.en: : Maybe...I did kinda freak out on you, so...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……我当时确实有点冲你发疯，所以……

lines.en: : Are you going to freak out on me if I come inside?
lines.zh: : 那如果我进去，你会冲我发疯吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Of course not. You haven’t done anythin’ wrong.
lines.zh: : 哈？当然不会。你又没做错什么。

lines.en: : Then let me in before someone in the hall catches onto our secret friendship.
lines.zh: : 那就让我进去吧，免得走廊上有人发现我们的秘密友谊。

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene black
scene mikupjs1
: Hey. How are you doing?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你还好吗？

lines.en: : You're not...gonna just pretend that none of that stuff in the storage room ever happened, are you?...
lines.zh: : 你不会……打算假装储藏室里那些事从来没发生过吧？……

lines.en: : Maybe. Depends on what you think we should do.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。看你觉得我们该怎么做。

lines.en: : Did you want to talk about it? Because, as it stands, I am very confused.
lines.zh: : 你想谈谈那件事吗？因为就目前而言，我非常困惑。

lines.en: scene mikupjs2
: It’s not like I don’t wanna...I just don’t really know {i}how.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也不是我不想谈……只是我真的不知道该{i}怎么开口。{/i}

lines.en: : There's a lotta...bad stuff about me that I don’t like bringin’ up...so I do my best to keep it locked away, I guess...
lines.zh: : 我身上有很多……不好的事，我不太愿意提……所以我想，我尽量把它们锁起来就好……

lines.en: : I’m not going to ask you to talk about anything you don’t want to talk about.
lines.zh: : 我不会要求你谈任何你不想谈的事。

lines.en: : If you want to just hang out and pretend it never even happened, that’s fine with me as well.
lines.zh: : 如果你只想一起待着、假装那件事从未发生，我也没意见。

lines.en: scene mikupjs3
: Do you...really not hate me for yellin' at you like that?...
lines.zh: : 你……真的不恨我那样冲你吼吗？……

lines.en: : Even though I have no idea what caused it, I understand that you weren't yelling {i}at{/i} me. I just happened to be there.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不知道是什么引起的，但我明白你不是在冲{i}我{/i}吼。我只是碰巧在场而已。

lines.en: scene mikupjs4
: Oh man...that's such a relief...
lines.zh: : 哦天哪……真是太让人安心了……

lines.en: : I was really worried that I mighta screwed everythin’ up just when we were startin' to get close.
lines.zh: : 我真的很担心，就在我们刚开始变亲近的时候，我把一切都搞砸了。

lines.en: scene mikupjs5
: I, uhh...I ain't ever been friends with someone your age before.
lines.zh: : 我，呃……我从来没和你这个年纪的人交过朋友。

lines.en: : So I was kinda worried you were gonna think I was just some immature loser or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 所以我有点担心，你会觉得我只是个幼稚的废物什么的。

lines.en: : Miku. Listen to me.
lines.zh: : Miku。听我说。

lines.en: scene mikupjs5r
: Y...Yeah?
: You {i}are{/i} an immature loser.
lines.zh: : 你{i}就是{/i}个幼稚的废物。

lines.en: scene mikupjs6
: Huh?! What is this, some kinda setup?!
lines.zh: : 哈？！这算什么，你故意设套？！

lines.en: : I let you in and you use it to just make fun of me?!
lines.zh: : 我放你进来，你就是为了取笑我？！

lines.en: : Of course not. You didn’t let me finish.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。你都没让我说完。

lines.en: : I like you {i}because{/i} you’re an immature loser.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你，正是{i}因为{/i}你是个幼稚的废物。

lines.en: : So you {i}are{/i} here to make fun of me?!
lines.zh: : 所以你果然{i}是{/i}来取笑我的？！

lines.en: : Again, no. There’s nothing wrong with being immature.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不是。幼稚并没有什么不好。

lines.en: : You’re hyperactive and overly friendly....You’re enthusiastic about everything even though you have a hard time keeping up with certain topics.
lines.zh: : 你精力过剩，又过分热情……你对一切都充满干劲，尽管有些话题你跟不上。

lines.en: scene mikupjs3
: You’re excitable and spontaneous and a bunch of other things that sound annoying in large doses but, somehow, none of them are.
lines.zh: : 你容易激动，做事随性，还有一大堆别的特质——听上去量大起来会很烦人，可不知为何，它们一个都不烦人。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I like about you.
lines.zh: : 这正是我喜欢你的地方。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : But there is {i}nothing{/i} immature about whatever happened to you in the storage room.
lines.zh: : 但不管你在储藏室里发生了什么，那都跟幼稚{i}无关{/i}。

lines.en: : At all.
lines.zh: : 一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : So it’s okay. You don’t need to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 所以没关系。你不必为此担心。

lines.en: : Some things are just beyond our control.
lines.zh: : 有些事本来就超出我们的掌控。

lines.en: scene mikupjs7
: How the heck are you able to say all this embarrassin’ stuff with a straight face?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能面不改色地说出这些让人害臊的话啊？

lines.en: : Especially when we still barely even know each other...
lines.zh: : 尤其是我们明明还不太熟……

lines.en: : We were in the process of learning, though, weren't we?
lines.zh: : 不过我们正在慢慢了解彼此，不是吗？

lines.en: : We were...but now that the cat's out of the bag and there's clearly some stuff that isn’t easy for me to talk about, you’d probably have an easier time cozyin’ up to Makoto.
lines.zh: : 算是吧……可既然秘密已经败露，而我显然有些事没那么容易说出口，你大概会觉得跟 Makoto 亲近起来更容易。

lines.en: : At least when {i}she{/i} yells at you, you know it’s cuz’ you forgot your homework or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}她{/i}冲你吼的时候，你知道那是因为你忘了写作业之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t have homework. I’m the teacher.
lines.zh: : 我没有作业。我是老师。

lines.en: scene mikupjs5
: You know what I mean!
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思！

lines.en: : I just don’t wanna make things all complicated for ya when you’ve already got a bajillion other girls comin’ to ya with their problems.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想把你的事情搞得更复杂，毕竟已经有无数个女生带着自己的问题来找你了。

lines.en: : 'Specially when I'm too much of a scaredy cat to even talk about mine.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我自己还是个胆小鬼，连说都不敢说。

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m more than happy to pretend those problems don’t even exist. I do the same thing more often than not.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我非常乐意假装那些问题根本不存在。我自己也常常这么干。

lines.en: scene mikupjs7r
: You...have problems like that too, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你也有那样的问题吗？……

lines.en: scene everythingg
scene happy7
scene everythingg
scene happy7
scene everythingg
scene happy7
scene mikupjs7r2
: {s}You are the only one who's broken. I am simply here to fix you.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}唯一坏掉的人是你。我在这里，只是为了修好你。{/s}

lines.en: scene mikupjs7r
: Everyone has problems. And I'd wager that most people run from them instead of confronting them head on.
lines.zh: : 每个人都有问题。而且我敢说，大多数人都在逃避它们，而不是正面迎击。

lines.en: : You're good at running, aren't you? Just try running faster if they keep catching up to you.
lines.zh: : 你很擅长逃跑，对吧？如果它们一直追上你，那就试着跑得更快一点。

lines.en: : Try running...faster?...
lines.zh: : 试着……跑得更快？……

lines.en: : That's not me trying to rush you, either.
lines.zh: : 我也不是在催你。

lines.en: : I just don't want you to break.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你坏掉。

lines.en: : Can I hug you?
lines.zh: : 我能抱你吗？

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: scene mikupjs8
Miku wraps her arms around me softer than she did the last time we were at the soccer field.
lines.zh: Miku 伸手环住我，比上次在足球场时轻柔得多。

lines.en: I guess this is what it feels like to actually be embraced by her rather than used as some sort of makeshift weightlifting prop.
lines.zh: 我想，这就是真正被她拥抱的感觉，而不是被当成某种临时的举重器械。

lines.en: Call it the situation we've found ourselves in, but she seems much more fragile up close now that I can feel her.
lines.zh: 就当我们是受眼下处境所迫吧，可如今我能真切地感触到她，近在咫尺的她看起来脆弱得多。

lines.en: The idea of snapping her in half is all I can think of- and the sensation of her growing body pressing against mine backs me into a corner.
lines.zh: 我满脑子只想着把她折断成两半这件事——而她那具正在发育的身体压在我身上的触感，把我逼到了死角。

lines.en: For a moment, I even forget all of the other horrible things caught between us in the embrace.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我甚至忘记了夹在我们之间、被这个拥抱困住的所有其他可怕的事情。

lines.en: : Is this a weird time for me to ask ya to be our coach again?
lines.zh: : 我现在开口请你再当我们教练，是不是时机不太对？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有点，是啊。

lines.en: : Darn. I thought I might be able to play up the vulnerable thing and convince ya that way.
lines.zh: : 可恶。我还以为可以卖卖惨，用这招说服你呢。

lines.en: : I’ll agree sooner or later. You just need to keep bothering me about it.
lines.zh: : 我早晚都会答应的。你只要继续缠着我就行。

lines.en: : I plan on it. A few of the girls could use some of those magic hands of yours. Myself included.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么打算的。有几个女生需要你那双神奇的手。也包括我。

lines.en: scene mikupjs9
: Mm!~
I squeeze Miku’s shoulders lightly and she quivers in response.
lines.zh: 我轻轻捏了捏 Miku 的肩膀，她随之颤了一下。

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean right now, you know?...
lines.zh: : 我……不是指现在啦，你知道吗？……

lines.en: : Why not? It felt good, didn't it?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？感觉挺舒服的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Heck yes it felt good...but I’m also in my PJ’s and...not in the right mindset to get a massage right now.
lines.zh: : 当然很舒服……可我还穿着睡衣，而且……现在也没有接受按摩的心情。

lines.en: : You sure? It might help you relax a little.
lines.zh: : 你确定？说不定能让你放松一点。

lines.en: scene mikupjs10
: Save it for the field, coach.
lines.zh: : 留到球场上吧，教练。

lines.en: I stop squeezing and immediately feel Miku's body relax and slope further into mine.
lines.zh: 我停下手上动作，立刻感觉到 Miku 的身体放松下来，更加倾斜地靠进我怀里。

lines.en: It's fascinating how delicate she seems despite the countless hours she spends conditioning her body.
lines.zh: 尽管她花了无数个小时锻炼身体，她看起来却依然如此纤弱，这很不可思议。

lines.en: I'm sure a lot of that is due to the immense size difference between us, but...
lines.zh: 我敢肯定这多半是因为我们之间巨大的体型差，不过……

lines.en: Even if she were a foot taller...I somehow doubt it would change anything.
lines.zh: 就算她再高一英尺……我也不觉得会有什么改变。

lines.en: And even though she’s talking the same way she normally does and {i}acting{/i} the same way she normally does-
lines.zh: 尽管她说话的方式和平时一样，{i}举止{/i}也和平时一样——

lines.en: She feels entirely new.
lines.zh: 她给人的感觉却全然是崭新的。

lines.en: There’s much more to Miku that I’ve yet to learn. And I have no idea {i}when{/i} I will be able to learn it.
lines.zh: Miku 身上还有很多我尚未了解的东西。而我也不知道自己{i}什么时候{/i}才能了解。

lines.en: But if the things we don't know about each other give us an excuse to be together like this, I’m glad.
lines.zh: 不过，如果那些我们互不了解的部分，能成为我们这样相处的借口，那我很高兴。

lines.en: I'll remain in the dark for as long as it takes.
lines.zh: 要多久都行，我会一直蒙在鼓里。

lines.en: : You doin' okay? Looks like ya got caught up in thought for a sec.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？看起来你刚才陷入沉思了一会儿。

lines.en: : D’ya not like hugs or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是不喜欢拥抱什么的吧？

lines.en: : They’re okay I guess. I’m just trying to not move too quickly out of fear of snapping you in half.
lines.zh: : 还行吧，我想。我只是怕把你折成两半，所以尽量不动作太快。

lines.en: : I'd like to see you try. I'm a lot stronger than I look, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那你倒是试试看啊。我可比看起来结实多了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’ll arm wrestle ya right now, Sensei. You better watch out.
lines.zh: : 我现在就要跟你掰手腕，Sensei。你最好小心点。

lines.en: : I’m absolutely terrified, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我怕死了，Miku。

lines.en: Miku grabs my shirt and pulls herself closer with a bit more fervor this time.
lines.zh: Miku 抓住我的衬衫，这次带着多一点的热情把自己拉得更近。

lines.en: I'm surprised by her willingness to do so on account of me being {i}very{/i} aware throughout this entire conversation that she's not wearing a bra-
lines.zh: 她愿意这么做让我有些意外——毕竟整段对话里，我一直{i}非常{/i}清楚地意识到她没穿胸罩——

lines.en: But I guess that sort of thing just doesn't pop into her mind the same way it does mine.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这种事不会像跳进我脑子里那样，跳进她的脑子里。

lines.en: That's good.
lines.zh: 这很好。

lines.en: It means there's still some hope left for her.
lines.zh: 这说明她身上还剩下一些希望。

lines.en: : You know, Sensei...you might be twice my size, but I’ve got four times the willpower you do. And that's the X factor in helpin' anime characters win fights.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei……你的体型可能是我的两倍，可我的意志力是你的四倍。而那正是帮助动画角色打赢架的 X 因素。

lines.en: : Yeah, there is absolutely no way that is true. I should receive an award for the amount of willpower I have on display right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这绝对不可能。就凭我现在展现出来的意志力，我都该得个奖了。

lines.en: : No way, Jose. Miku Maruyama's the real protagonist here and she's gonna take you down one day after a lengthy training arc.
lines.zh: : 想得美，老兄。真正的主角是 Miku Maruyama，等一段漫长的修炼剧情之后，总有一天她会把你打败。

lines.en: : Why are we even fighting? Can't we just keep hanging out?
lines.zh: : 我们到底在打什么？就不能继续这么待着吗？

lines.en: : You said you were gonna snap me. I've got a right to defend myself.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说要把我折断。我有权自卫。

lines.en: : If your method for defending yourself involves clutching my shirt and hugging me, you might want to start your training arc early.
lines.zh: : 如果你的自卫方式是抓着我的衬衫抱我，那你的修炼剧情可能得提前开工了。

lines.en: scene mikupjs8
: Nah. You’re in trouble as long as I’ve got a hold on you.
lines.zh: : 才不。只要我还抓着你，你就有麻烦了。

lines.en: : And...how long do you intend to hold me, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……你到底打算抓我多久？

lines.en: : For as long as you'll let me.
lines.zh: : 只要你让我抓多久，就多久。

lines.en: scene black
Despite her final line before a bout of silence, Miku eventually lets go without me having to ask her to.
lines.zh: 尽管她在陷入沉默前说了那样一句话，Miku 最终还是松开了手，不需要我开口。

lines.en: It's good that she does, too, because I wasn't sure how much longer I was going to be able to take that for without doing something I may regret.
lines.zh: 她这么做也挺好的，因为我不确定自己还能再撑多久而不做出什么日后会后悔的事。

lines.en: As our bodies part, she takes a moment to collect herself and breathes in deeply- like she's getting ready for a fifty-yard dash.
lines.zh: 我们的身体分开时，她花了一点时间让自己平复下来，然后深深吸了一口气——就像准备跑五十码冲刺似的。

lines.en: But, instead of taking off down the hall in a sprint, she simply turns to me instead.
lines.zh: 可她并没有沿着走廊冲刺跑掉，而只是转过身面对我。

lines.en: scene mikupjs3
: I’m...sorry again for yellin’ at you, Sensei. If it makes ya feel any better, I'll let you yell stuff at me sometime.
lines.zh: : 我……再次为冲你吼的事道歉，Sensei。如果这样能让你好受点，改天我让你也冲我吼几句。

lines.en: : That won’t be necessary, but thanks.
lines.zh: : 那倒不必，不过谢谢你。

lines.en: : You sure? I can take it. I swear.
lines.zh: : 你确定？我扛得住。我发誓。

lines.en: : I’m not going to yell at you, Miku...
lines.zh: : 我不会冲你吼的，Miku……

lines.en: scene mikupjs7
: Fine...but if ya ever change your mind, you know where to find me!
lines.zh: : 好吧……不过要是你哪天改变主意了，你知道去哪儿找我！

lines.en: : And if I’m not here, you can always...check the soccer field or...the streets or....anywhere else that’s good for runnin’.
lines.zh: : 要是我不在这儿，你还可以……去足球场看看，或者……街上，或者……任何适合跑步的地方。

lines.en: : Oh! And umm...speakin’ of which, we should totally go for a run together soon.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有嗯……说到这个，我们改天一定要一起去跑步。

lines.en: : Just think about it! The wind in our faces! The sweat drippin’ from our pores!
lines.zh: : 想想看！风迎面吹来！汗水从毛孔里滴下来！

lines.en: : Just you and me and the night!
lines.zh: : 只有你、我和这夜晚！

lines.en: : That sounds great other than the sweat part. And the wind part.
lines.zh: : 除了出汗那部分，听起来很不错。还有刮风那部分。

lines.en: : And the running part.
lines.zh: : 还有跑步那部分。

lines.en: : Actually, all of that sounds pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 说真的，这些听起来都挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll get ya into it! I swear!
lines.zh: : 哼，我一定会让你爱上的！我发誓！

lines.en: : You’ll be trainin’ for the Hakone before ya even know it!
lines.zh: : 你还没反应过来，就已经在为了箱根驿传训练了！

lines.en: : Whatever you say, Miku...
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说吧，Miku……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us say our goodbyes and Miku jumps into my arms for another hug.
lines.zh: 我们两个道了别，Miku 又跳进我怀里抱了一次。

lines.en: Part of me wants to hold her longer, but the time we've had is enough for today.
lines.zh: 我有一部分想抱她更久一些，不过今天共度的这些时光已经足够了。

lines.en: I still don’t understand the extent of whatever Miku’s issues are, so I want to be careful to not hurt her any more than she’s already hurting.
lines.zh: 我仍然不清楚 Miku 的问题到底有多严重，所以我想小心一点，别让她在她已经承受的痛苦之外再受伤害。

lines.en: {i}If{/i} her pain is worth worrying over in the first place.
lines.zh: {i}如果{/i}她的痛苦一开始值得担忧的话。

lines.en: With the way she normally acts, it’s hard to tell.
lines.zh: 看她平时的样子，实在很难判断。

lines.en: I make my way back into the street and, for a moment, contemplate whether or not I want to try jogging.
lines.zh: 我走回街上，有那么一瞬间，认真考虑了自己要不要试试慢跑。
